why: code resolves PREPARED to ABORT at recovery start with no confirmation step — assumption is the operation itself
claim forbids truncation without an explicit storage norm and evidence; code truncates on recovery start with no such precondition
test asserts exactly the behaviour the claim forbids; test and design norm cannot both hold

structural: precedence semantics require a comparison path with Canonical History; no Canonical History surface exists in the code corpus, so the requirement cannot be satisfied — code resolves status from its local tx table alone
recovery-evidence precedence is undecided in the design; two surfaces encode opposite rules (wal.lisp resolves at start, bridge is fail-closed)
